{{Quote|Sergeant Lex here is our demolitions expert. Locked doors, no matter how thick, are no match for his explosives.|Bant Eerin|<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" />}}
'''Lex''' was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] and [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] who served in the [[Eighteenth Battalion]], a [[Battalion/Legends|unit]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Herc]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the battalion participated in a [[Battle of Akoshissss|battle]] on the [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Akoshissss]]. During the battle, Lex was sent to infiltrate [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Cyberneticist/Legends|cyberneticist]] [[Bitt Panith]]'s [[Bitt Panith's secret base|laboratory]].

==Biography==
Lex was the nickname of a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] and [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" /> Like all other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Lex was a [[Cloning/Legends|biological reproduction]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], born on<ref name="DB Clone troopers" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="DB Clone troopers" /> After his creation, he served the [[Eighteenth Battalion]] under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Herc]].<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Cyberneticist/Legends|cyberneticist]] [[Bitt Panith]] created [[Krossen]], a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] immune to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. In response, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] [[Battle of Akoshissss|sent]] Lex and the Eighteenth [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] to the [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Akoshissss]], where Krossen was in the final stages of development.<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" />
{{RPG}}
During the ensuing battle, [[Bant Eerin's Padawan]], [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Jaylen Kos]], the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R3-G0]], and Lex infiltrated [[Bitt Panith's secret base]] in an attempt to destroy the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist's]] [[Bitt Panith's starship|starship]] and trap him inside the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]].<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sir, I recommend caution. As long as we take out the doctor's ship, he won't be going anywhere.|Lex, to Bant Eerin's Padawan|<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" />}}
Lex was a cautious clone, knowing that as long as [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Panith's ship was destroyed, the Republic strike force would not have to worry about him escaping, even if the Doctor's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces were not defeated. Lex was trained in the use of heavy weapons, including explosives such as [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" /> Like his [[Clone template/Legends|clone template]] Jango Fett, Lex stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="DB Clone troopers" />

==Equipment==
Lex wore heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with [[Color/Legends|purple]] markings.<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lex's only appearance to date is in ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi]]'', a novel based on the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The novel was written by [[Jake Forbes]] and was released in [[2008]].<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" /> Lex is also featured in the novel's [http://www.starwars.com/decideyourdestiny online content] on [[StarWars.com]]. Lex's online appearance differs from his description in the novel, most notably the lack of purple markings in his online appearance.<ref name="Online">{{SWArchive|url=decideyourdestiny|text=''Clone Wars: Decide your Destiny''|nobackup=1}}</ref>

===Alternative outcomes===
Because ''The Way of the Jedi'' is a [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny|''Decide Your Destiny'']] book, there are many different possible outcomes for the events within, which are dependent on choices made by the reader. After infiltrating Panith's base, Eerin's Padawan, Kos, R3-G0, and Lex have a choice as to whether to follow Panith into a laboratory or to follow a group of the Doctor's [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] into a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. If the reader decides that the strike team should follow the droids, Lex volunteers to blow up Panith's starship, which is located within the hangar. R3-G0 then goes aboard the ship and, if the reader chooses for Eerin's Padawan to not to follow the droid aboard, Lex sets off some explosives and is subsequently killed when [[Poison/Legends|poison]] gas is released into the hangar bay. Later that night, the clone troopers on Akoshissss hold a wake to honor Lex and the other clones lost in the battle on the moon. If the reader does choose for Eerin's Padawan to follow R3-G0, the Padawan, Lex, and Kos are inside the ship when the gas is released, which protects them from the gas's effects. Lex then blows the ship up, and the team members subsequently capture Panith.<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" />

If the reader chooses to follow Panith rather than the MagnaGuards when the strike team enters the base, Eerin's Padawan and Kos leave Lex to stand guard while they go to deal with Panith. Soon afterward, Lex abandons his post and goes to assist the Jedi pair, and he shoots Krossen in the chest. The reader then has to chose between having Eerin's Padawan help Lex battle Krossen, or going after Panith instead. If the Padawan assists Lex, then Lex draws Krossen into a doorway, and R3-G0 shuts the doors on the creature, allowing Lex to kill Krossen. If the reader chooses to pursue Panith, Lex kills Krossen using an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|EMP bomb]], which also disables R3-G0. Lex then carries the droid while he and the two Jedi return to Bant Eerin's command center.<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" />
